players.product: Optical communication components (optical-path design and optical-component packaging) for data-center and AI products; entering precision plastic/metal mechanical parts for CPO (e.g. MT ferrule for CPO, ELSFP dissipation connector component) via the Pingood acquisition

quarterly_data.quarter: PCL Technologies MOPS material information: release 4977-20260506-2 (05-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Board resolved on 2026-05-08 to acquire 100% of Pingood Enterprise Co., Ltd., Pingood (Thailand) Co., Ltd. and two Pingood electronics companies in Dongguan and Suzhou (the Pingood group): a nearly 45-year-old Taiwanese maker of micro plastic fasteners with plants in Greater China and Southeast Asia, over 400 staff and over ten thousand SKUs used in data centers, power supplies, thermal modules, AI PCs, networking, energy and electric vehicles; the company says the deal takes it into high-precision plastic and metal mechanical components, optimises its product design and cost structure, uses Pingood's customer network and expands data-center supply in thermal, connection and structural support; Pingood management stays
quarterly_data.figure: 100% of the Pingood group; over 400 staff

quarterly_data.quarter: PCL Technologies MOPS material information: release 4977-20260506-2 (05-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company view: it has years of R&D and production in optical communication components, using optical-path design and optical-component packaging to help customers mass-produce products for data-center construction and AI; co-packaged optics (CPO) is seen as the most critical core technology for data centers and AI, and its precision mechanical parts (e.g. MT Ferrule for CPO, ELSFP Dissipation Connector Component) provide physical support, positioning and low-loss connection for optoelectronic devices, driver ICs, ASIC/GPU switch chips and ELSFP external light sources
